title: CODEX Preparation of Reporter 96-Well Plates
author: Jerelyn Nick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc2riyd6

steps.title: Prepare Reporter Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Reporter Stock Solution according to the number of cycles and coverslips to be run (e.g., for 5 cycles).

steps.title: Label amber tubes
steps.instruction: Label a 1.5 mL amber microcentrifuge tube for each cycle, including tubes for the blank cycles at the beginning and end of the experiment.

steps.title: Aliquot stock into tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot Reporter Stock Solution into each labeled tube using the volumes indicated in the CODEX Cycle Template (volumes vary with the number of reporters in the cycle).

steps.title: Add reporters and mix
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate Akoya Reporters to each tube to create a Reporter Master Mix for the cycle, using the volumes listed in step 2.2 column A of the cycle template or reporter tray template. Keep the tubes on ice, briefly spin them in a bench‑top centrifuge, and return them to ice.

steps.title: Load 96‑well reporter plate
steps.instruction: Pipette 245 µL of each Reporter Master Mix into the corresponding well of a 96‑well Reporter Plate. Use a fresh 96‑well plate for each set of cycles.

steps.title: Seal and store plates
steps.instruction: Lightly cover entire rows of wells (e.g., B1‑B12) with foil seal strips, keep the plates in the dark to avoid photobleaching, and store at 4 °C for up to two weeks.
